newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS ACQUIRE OLCZYK FROM KINGS FOR MURRAY.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-PENGUINS ACQUIRE OLCZYK FROM KINGS FOR MURRAY.

text.p: The Los Angeles Kings dealt 13-year veteran Eddie Olczyk to the Pittsburgh Penguins for young right winger Glen Murray just prior to Tuesday's trading deadline.
Olczyk, who signed with the Kings as a free agent in July, has 21 goals and 23 assists in 67 games this season. The 31-year-old centre has 734 points (315 goals, 419 assists) in 869 career NHL games.
Murray, 24, a first-round draft choice of the Boston Bruins in 1991, has spent the last two seasons in Pittsburgh. He has 11 goals and 11 assists in 66 games this season.
In 283 games in the NHL, Murray has 54 goals and 56 assists for 100 points with 183 penalty minutes.
"He basically fits in with our direction," Kings coach Larry Robinson said of the big right winger. "He's young with size, grit and a big shot. He'll add the kind of intangibles we've been missing."
